notes.title: July Release For Sequel
notes.notes:
The next chapter will be released in July 2018.
For updates, please follow the Facebook page https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26384136/afe0615ae0cddb3e15028df006615d4f69ac2012.jpg


www.facebook.com/archimedesthegame

notes.title: Archimedes set for early October release
notes.notes:
Indie-horror game Archimedes is ready to release on Steam in October 2016. 

Archimedes is now also set to come to Linux-based operating systems due to popular early demand.
